propositions: Compiled `plan_review_phase` is set to `execution` when winning status target enters `in_progress`, `planning` when entering `open`, and preserved for all other targets.
Losing fork STATUS events and non-winning branches never update the phase projection; force transitions follow the same winning target rule.
Manifest execution phase requires exactly one `priority-floor: 0.80` line; planning omits the floor; execution floors below 0.80 are rejected as incompatible.
Phase compatibility: planning state accepts planning/legacy attestations and rejects execution; execution state accepts planning/legacy and execution floor >= 0.80.
Re-sign parses persisted `plan_review_result_v2` phase metadata, compares against compiled phase, and refuses re-signature for incompatible or malformed variants.
Pass-3 execution review floors the blocking threshold to 0.80 only when `execution_review=True` and blocking is enabled; planning review uses original thresholds unchanged.
